notes.title: Arctic Eggs OST Release!
notes.notes: The Arctic Eggs soundtrack has just released on Steam! This games story and atmosphere owe everything to the incredible work done by Cameron Ginex, a talented composer and great friend. Give it a listen if you are able.

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for all of your support so far! Here is a list of changes made in this newest update. Mostly some quick difficulty/bug fixes.

[list]
[*]Fish/Puffer Fish don't jump as frequently or as strong. 
[*]Bullet spawn rate has been reduced slightly
[*]Toilet achievement fixed
[*]Fixed a few text/translation errors (still a couple more that need to be ironed out)
[/list]

Thank you for all your feedback, I am still working on many things aimed at fixing/improving the game!
